title: Since the GENIUS Act's passage in July, the total value of stablecoins circulating rose from ~$250B to $300B+, as they become the "respectable" face of crypto (Joel Khalili/Wired)
summary: Joel Khalili / Wired: Since the GENIUS Act's passage in July, the total value of stablecoins circulating rose from ~$250B to $300B+, as they become the “respectable” face of crypto — In a year that began with a memecoin trading frenzy, stablecoins have emerged as the respectable face of the crypto industry.
